items.title: Inspect the throttle position sensor system.

substeps.text: Turn the ignition switch to ON. Do not start the engine.
Connect a voltmeter to the DG terminal and body ground.
While slowly depressing the accelerator pedal, check that DG terminal voltage rises in sequence.

content.text: If the voltage is in proportion to the throttle opening angle and does not change, there is a malfunction with the throttle position sensor or circuit.

substeps.text: Depress the accelerator pedal to where DG terminal indicates 8V.
Depress the brake pedal and check the voltage reading for DG terminal.

content.text: If not as indicated, there is a malfunction with either the stop light switch or circuit.

substeps.text: Place the pattern select switch in ''Normal'' and the shift selector in ''D'' range.
During a road test (above 10 km/h or 6 mph) check that voltage at the DG terminal is as indicated below for each up-shift position.
